articles.title: SBI Group backs payments firm dtcpay in $25 million funding round
articles.snippet: Stablecoin payments company dtcpay completed a $25 million Series A funding round with a strategic investment from Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
articles.snippet: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.

articles.title: HYPE hits record above $90 as Hyperliquid launches manual borrowing
articles.snippet: HYPE hit a record $90.92 after Hyperliquid opened manual borrowing, letting users borrow stablecoins against HYPE and Bitcoin collateral.

articles.title: Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25M round with SBI backing
articles.snippet: Dtcpay plans to expand its merchant network and payment products after completing a $25 million Series A backed by Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
articles.snippet: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.
